title: Pure Madolche
summary: Pure Madolche combo and control deck, utilizing fairy-tale sweets that recycle into the Deck and hand. The deck excels at spinning opponent cards without targeting via multi-stage Xyz rank-ups while keeping the graveyard clear of monsters.

summary.title: Starters
points: Madolche Petingcessoeur Special Summons itself from hand if you have no monsters in your GY, then Special Summons any Madolche monster from Deck with its Level reduced by 1, locking Extra Deck summons to Madolche monsters.
Madolche Magileine adds any Madolche monster from Deck to hand when Normal Summoned.
Madolche Anjelly Tributes itself to Special Summon any Madolche monster from the Deck with battle destruction immunity.
Madolche Hootcake banishes a monster from the GY to Special Summon any Madolche monster from the Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Madolche Petingcessoeur
steps: Special Summon Madolche Petingcessoeur from your hand with an empty GY.
Activate Petingcessoeur on summon to Special Summon Madolche Puddingcess from the Deck at Level 4.
Overlay Petingcessoeur and Puddingcess into Madolche Teacher Glassouffle.
Detach Puddingcess to activate Glassouffle's effect targeting herself, making her unaffected by monster effects.

Rank up Glassouffle into Madolche Puddingcess Chocolat-a-la-Mode, and use its effect to shuffle Puddingcess back into the Deck, triggering Chocolat-a-la-Mode to detach a material and Special Summon Madolche Anjelly from the Deck.
Tribute Anjelly to Special Summon Madolche Butlerusk from the Deck, which adds Madolche Chateau to hand, and link into Madolche Fresh Sistart.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Madolche Queen Tiaramisu detaches a material to shuffle up to 2 Madolche cards from your GY into the Deck, then shuffles an equal number of cards the opponent controls into the Deck without targeting.

Madolche Queen Tiarafraise overlays directly onto Tiaramisu, shuffling cards your opponent controls into the Deck as a Quick Effect during their turn whenever a Madolche card returns to your hand or Deck.

Madolche Teacher Glassouffle targets a Madolche monster to grant it monster effect immunity on either turn, and shuffles up to 2 cards from either GY into the Deck to disrupt opposing graveyard setups.
Madolche Fresh Sistart shields Madolche Spells and Traps from effect destruction while pointing to a Madolche monster, and can shuffle a Madolche monster from GY to protect herself.
Madolche Mini Meowcaroons is a Link-3 that searches any Madolche card upon summon and can Special Summon a Madolche monster from the hand or GY.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Madolche Chateau gives all Madolche monsters 500 ATK and DEF, and redirects any Madolche monster returning from the GY to the Deck back to your hand instead.
Madolche Salon grants an additional Normal Summon of a Madolche monster each turn, and Sets a Madolche Spell/Trap directly from the Deck whenever a Madolche card returns to your Deck or hand.

Madolche Promenade negates the effects of an opponent's face-up card on the field while returning a Madolche card from your field or GY to hand/Deck, then attaches a Madolche from hand or GY to an Xyz Monster.
Madolche Dessert bounces two monsters back to the hand or Deck to Special Summon a higher-Level Madolche monster from the Deck or Extra Deck.
Madolche Tea Break negates an activated opponent's Spell or Trap Card while you have no monsters in your GY and bounces it to the hand.
